thesis: GMAB is up roughly 110% in 126 days on a news-driven re-rating, trades at a rich 48.5x trailing and 35.9x forward earnings, and sits 5% under its 52-week high with RSI near 69. The current bounce came on a 0.77 volume ratio, so it lacks confirmation. The setup only pays on a breakout, because a target at the 52-week high gives about 0.7 R/R. The regime is risk-off at 0.9 confidence with QQQ below both its 50- and 200-day averages, and a thin half-day session after the holiday makes a stop fill unreliable. The Darzalex royalty cliff is an unresolved overhang, and the packet cannot verify earnings acceleration because the SEC quarterly series is empty. Earnings growth is already negative while revenue grows.
